name: Tangle Sandbox

modes.label: General pool, platform default runtime (per-second, allocated vCPU + memory + disk)
modes.note: Rates from the public, unauthenticated https://sandbox.tangle.tools/v1/pricing/sandboxes (pool 'general', self-reported source 'reference-constants'): $0.010446/vCPU-h, $0.007051/GB-h memory, $0.0007345/GB-h disk, hourly floor $0.04/h per sandbox. Billing rule from https://sandbox.tangle.tools/llms.txt: "A running sandbox accrues per second from the owner's prepaid credit at an hourly rate of vCPU x cpuCoreHourUsd + memory GB x memoryGBHourUsd + disk GB x diskGBHourUsd, never below minChargeHourUsd." Basis is the sandbox's vCPU / memory / disk (its granted size), so cpu/ram basis = alloc. Memory is priced per GB; the card treats GB as GiB (Tangle sizes memory in memoryMB). min_charge_hour_usd models the $0.04/h minimum across allocated CPU, memory, and running disk; it binds below $0.04/h shapes (1 vCPU / 1 GB / 10 GB = $0.0248/h is billed $0.04/h). Minimum billed seconds and any per-start fee are not published (null). Max vCPU / RAM / disk per sandbox not published (client.shapes() returns them to signed-in accounts only). Rates are shown on https://sandbox.tangle.tools/pricing only to signed-in users; signed-out visitors see plans but no compute rates. Re-checked 2026-11-08: same rates. https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cost: 'Per second while the sandbox runs: vCPU, memory, and disk', never below an hourly minimum. The default runtime is not published ('omit it for the platform default').

modes.label: General pool, Firecracker microVM runtime (runtime: "firecracker"; same published rates)
modes.note: Same rates as the general pool: the public price endpoint https://sandbox.tangle.tools/v1/pricing/sandboxes lists one pool (general), and https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cost prices compute by vCPU, memory and disk only, with no runtime surcharge. Runtime from https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript: "runtime: \"firecracker\" runs a microVM instead of a container; omit it for the platform default." Root and Docker inside the microVM are not published.

storage.note: disk_gib_month = diskGBHourUsd $0.0007344571932921447 x 730 h: Tangle bills the sandbox disk GB per running hour ("disk GB x diskGBHourUsd"), which the engine prices as extra disk x running hours / 730 x disk_gib_month. https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cost: "A stopped sandbox does not accrue compute." and "A stopped sandbox keeps its files and sessions." Disk is metered as part of compute while the sandbox runs and the page lists no separate storage charge, so disk_billed_when_stopped = false. Snapshot storage prices are not published.

evidence.quote: Any host. Ask for it with egressPolicy: { mode: "open" }.
The hosts in allowDomains, plus the model endpoint and providers the platform provisioned into the sandbox.

internet.note: Three outbound modes are documented. A sandbox created without a policy reaches package registries (npm, PyPI, crates.io, RubyGems, Go), GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, container registries and model endpoints, and nothing else (https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/egress). That default is a fixed allowlist, not one of the three modes, so default is left unset. Open internet is one setting (mode: "open").

network.note: Egress: Free 100 GiB per account, refused beyond it, never charged; Pro 2 TB then $0.05/GB; Team 2 TB then $0.04/GB. Inbound free. The public JSON https://sandbox.tangle.tools/v1/pricing/egress (re-checked 2026-11-08) gives scope 'account' for all three plans, and https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cost says 'the plan's per-account monthly allowance, shared by its sandboxes'. The plan feature strings still say 'per sandbox'; the card follows the JSON and the cost page. egress_gib = $0.05/GB (Pro) converted to $/GiB; the engine has one account-wide egress rate, so Team's $0.04/GB is a caveat.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Plan id 'free', named 'Free' in the plans API (https://id.tangle.tools/api/v1/plans, re-checked 2026-11-08); the pricing page shows it as '$0 / month' / 'Pay for usage'. Features: '1 concurrent sandbox', '3 snapshots per sandbox', '100 GiB egress per account each month, refused beyond it, never charged'. No free credit: usage is paid from prepaid credit ('Sandbox has no free tier or free credit.').

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: $29.99/month with a $29.99 monthly credit. Features: 'Unlimited sandboxes', '10 snapshots per sandbox', '2 TB egress per sandbox each month, then $0.05/GB' (the egress JSON gives scope 'account'). Concurrency published as unlimited: limits.concurrent -1. Left null because the engine has no unlimited value; the engine then assumes Free's 1 (see caveats). The plan object also lists products.blueprintAgent.maxActiveContainers 3: that limit belongs to Tangle's agent product, not to sandbox concurrency. Whether unused credit rolls over is not published.

plans.name: Team
plans.note: Plan id 'enterprise', name 'Team': $99/month with a $99 monthly credit. Features: 'Unlimited sandboxes', '25 snapshots per sandbox', '2 TB egress per sandbox each month, then $0.04/GB' (egress JSON scope 'account'; engine prices egress at Pro's $0.05/GB). Concurrency published as unlimited (limits.concurrent -1), null for the same reason as Pro. The plan object lists products.blueprintAgent.maxActiveContainers 5 (agent product). Seat pricing not published.

caveats: Compute rates come from the unauthenticated JSON endpoint https://sandbox.tangle.tools/v1/pricing/sandboxes, linked as 'Machine-readable prices: no key needed' from https://sandbox.tangle.tools/llms.txt and https://sandbox.tangle.tools/.well-known/tangle-agent.json. The human pricing page https://sandbox.tangle.tools/pricing renders plans to everyone but compute rates only to signed-in users. The endpoint labels its numbers source 'reference-constants'; whether a signed-in account (or a paid plan) sees different rates is not published.

Billing rule (per second, allocated vCPU + memory GB + disk GB, hourly floor $0.04) is published in https://sandbox.tangle.tools/llms.txt and https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cost ("Per second while the sandbox runs: vCPU, memory, and disk", never below an hourly minimum). A stopped sandbox accrues no compute and keeps its files.
The hourly minimum minChargeHourUsd $0.04/h per running sandbox is modelled by min_charge_hour_usd across allocated CPU, memory, and running disk, prorated per second.
Memory and disk are priced per GB; the card uses them as per GiB (about 7% difference if Tangle means decimal GB).

Isolation: a sandbox runs on the platform default runtime, or as a Firecracker microVM when you set runtime: "firecracker" (https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript). The default runtime is not published, so the general mode leaves isolation null and a separate firecracker mode carries isolation "firecracker" at the same rates. Max vCPU / memory / disk per sandbox and regions are not published.

Pro and Team have unlimited concurrent sandboxes: they list 'Unlimited sandboxes' and the plans JSON has limits.concurrent -1 (Free: 1). The engine has no unlimited value, so concurrency is null and the engine assumes Free's 1 for them; Pro and Team are wrongly shown as capped at 1 until the engine can read an unlimited plan cap. The plans JSON also lists maxActiveContainers 3 (Pro) and 5 (Team) under products.blueprintAgent, Tangle's agent product.
Free plan ('Pay as you go' on the page) has no free credit: agent-setup.md says 'Sandbox has no free tier or free credit.' Usage needs prepaid credit.

Egress allowance is per account on every plan (egress JSON scope 'account'; cost page 'per-account monthly allowance, shared by its sandboxes'), although the plan feature strings say 'per sandbox'. Team's overage is $0.04/GB; the engine uses Pro's $0.05/GB for all plans.

Snapshot storage, minimum billed seconds and start fees are not published (null). idleTimeoutSeconds, maxLifetimeSeconds, coldTimeoutSeconds and deleteAfterStoppedSeconds exist; an unset option takes the platform default (https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cost).

GPU leases attach a GPU from RunPod, Vast.ai, Lambda Labs or Modal (examples: nvidia-3090, nvidia-4090, nvidia-h100), billed in seconds. The current GPU price shows only in the CLI (tangle sandbox gpu providers), not on a public price list, so GPU workloads are not priceable here.

Tangle's own fleet doc (https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-fleet) says: 'On that day Claude Code, Hermes, Pi, Kimi Code and OpenClaw failed on production before their first model call', and that Codex needed apiKeyEnv. The page does not give the date.

Confidential compute: Tangle's comparison page lists 'TEE attestation, sealed-secret encryption' as a Tangle feature and says Tangle 'is the only one with platform-level attestation today' (https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/comparison). The card has no feature key for it.

Desktop: the product page https://sandbox.tangle.tools/ advertises 'Shell, files, ports, desktop and trace from the SDK and CLI'. No frame rate, stream or computer-use API is documented; the MCP docs list computer_use only as an optional capability scope.
Preview links: a sandbox can publish a preview link under any egress policy (https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/egress). Whether preview links are public or token-protected is not documented.
Perf fields are empty pending measured runs.

fleet.verification: Prepaid credit is required before the first sandbox (agent-setup.md: HTTP 403 paid_access_required).
fleet.tiers: Free 1 concurrent sandbox; Pro $29.99/month and Team $99/month 'Unlimited sandboxes' (plans JSON limits.concurrent -1, unlimited).
fleet.notes: Docs list per-fleet safety limits (8 sandbox creates in flight, maxConcurrentCreates) for the Fleet SDK; account-level create-rate limits are not published.

pricing_basis.quote: A running sandbox accrues per second from the owner's prepaid credit at an hourly rate of vCPU x cpuCoreHourUsd + memory GB x memoryGBHourUsd + disk GB x diskGBHourUsd, never below minChargeHourUsd.
pricing_basis.note: Same sentence in agent-setup.md and the agent manifest. https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cost: "Per second while the sandbox runs: vCPU, memory, and disk."

compute_rates.note: Public, unauthenticated JSON. The pricing page shows these rates only to signed-in users.

plans.note: The pricing page fetches https://id.tangle.tools/api/v1/plans and renders name, monthlyPriceCents as '$X / month', creditsPerMonth as '$X monthly credit' (or 'Pay for usage' when 0) and each features string. Quote is fragments of the API response, joined with ' ... '.

plan_concurrency.note: Free, Pro, Team in order; fragments joined with ' ... '. -1 is the unlimited value. Plan concurrency stays null for Pro/Team because the engine has no unlimited value. The same objects list products.blueprintAgent.maxActiveContainers 1 / 3 / 5 (Tangle agent product, not sandbox concurrency).

no_free_credit.quote: The owner's account has no credit. Sandbox has no free tier or free credit.
no_free_credit.note: Error table row for HTTP 403 paid_access_required.

egress.quote: Outbound bytes beyond the plan's per-account monthly allowance, shared by its sandboxes.
egress.note: JSON at https://sandbox.tangle.tools/v1/pricing/egress (2026-11-08): {"period":"calendar-month","metered":"outbound","bytesPerGb":1000000000,"plans":{"free":{"scope":"account","includedBytes":107374182400,"overage":"refused","usdPerGb":0},"pro":{"scope":"account","includedBytes":2000000000000,"overage":"billed","usdPerGb":0.05},"enterprise":{"scope":"account","includedBytes":2000000000000,"overage":"billed","usdPerGb":0.04}}}. Plan feature strings still say per sandbox.

snapshot.note: Filesystem snapshots on demand; snapshot restore creates a new sandbox, snapshot revert rolls back in place (CLI docs). No memory snapshot is documented.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: snapshot restore creates a new sandbox from a snapshot. snapshot revert rolls the existing sandbox back to the snapshot in place.

pause_resume.quote: stop() suspends supported Sandboxes while preserving state.
pause_resume.note: Qualified by 'supported'. Whether memory and processes survive is not stated. Cost page: 'A stopped sandbox keeps its files and sessions.'

persistent_disk.quote: A stopped sandbox keeps its files and sessions.
persistent_disk.note: Whether the whole disk or only the workspace survives is not stated (persist_scope unset). deleteAfterStoppedSeconds deletes a stopped sandbox after a set time; the default is not published. A stopped sandbox accrues no compute.

fork.quote: snapshot restore creates a new sandbox from a snapshot.
fork.note: Fork = snapshot, then restore into a new sandbox. Published templates can also be forked. Forking a running sandbox without a snapshot is not stated.

auto_stop_idle.quote: Stops the sandbox after this long with no activity.
auto_stop_idle.note: idleTimeoutSeconds create option. An unset option takes the platform default, documented on CreateSandboxOptions in the TypeScript SDK.

custom_image.quote: Set it only when you need a custom container image or an image ID returned by the image builder:
custom_image.note: Published snapshots also serve as templates (https://sandbox.tangle.tools/docs/templates).

image_oci.quote: Set it only when you need a custom container image or an image ID returned by the image builder:
image_oci.note: Container images. The Dockerfile page cited before (sdk/images-storage) is gone (404).

ssh.quote: tangle ssh invokes your system ssh through the Sandbox API WebSocket proxy.
ssh.note: Tunnelled through the API (tangle ssh-proxy), not a public SSH port.

inbound_https.quote: A box can create sibling sandboxes or publish a preview link under any policy.
inbound_https.note: Preview links published through the control plane. Whether they are public or token-protected is not documented. The web app lists exposed ports per sandbox.

egress_allowlist.quote: The hosts in allowDomains, plus the model endpoint and providers the platform provisioned into the sandbox.
egress_allowlist.note: egressPolicy modes open / strict (allowDomains) / blocked. Domain lists only; no IP/CIDR rules documented.

open_internet.quote: Any host. Ask for it with egressPolicy: { mode: "open" }.
open_internet.note: One setting. A sandbox created without a policy reaches registries, git hosts and model endpoints only.

agent_harnesses.quote: A cloud agent is a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode) running in its own Linux sandbox.
agent_harnesses.note: Tangle's own fleet doc reports Claude Code failing on production on one measured day (see caveats).

harness_api.quote: dispatchPrompt(message, { sessionId, turnId }) returns after admission and lets the run continue after the caller disconnects.
harness_api.note: First-party prompt/session API (box.prompt, box.session(id).prompt, streamPrompt) over the chosen harness.

code_interpreter.quote: Code exec with structured results (image / dataframe / json / html)
code_interpreter.note: Comparison table row marked for Tangle. https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-mcp: "the persistent kernel behind sandbox_run_code is stateful."

browser.note: The Playwright/Chromium template line cited on 2026-10-11 is no longer on https://sandbox.tangle.tools/docs/templates; the default image lists Python 3.12 and Node 22 only. Templates are listed by the CLI (tangle template list). Not confirmed on a public page.

computer_use.note: computer_use appears only as an optional MCP capability scope in a code sample; what it controls is not documented. The old sdk/interactive source is gone (404).

credential_injection.quote: Secrets are encrypted key/value pairs injected into the sandbox environment at boot.
credential_injection.note: Injected as environment variables at boot. A secret with a proxy policy stays out of the sandbox instead (see secret_proxy).

scoped_api_keys.note: Credential types: account API key (sk-tan-), session, project, session-runtime, read-only and capability tokens.

spend_limits.quote: Calls with that key stop when it has spent its budget.
spend_limits.note: Per-key budget (--budget-usd); GPU leases also take maxSpendUsd.

gpu.quote: Supported provider names are runpod, vast-ai, lambda-labs, and modal.
gpu.note: Leases attach to an ordinary sandbox only while a command needs a GPU. Examples use nvidia-3090, nvidia-4090 and nvidia-h100. "Billing is recorded in seconds." The current GPU price shows only in the CLI (gpu providers), so mode.gpu is null.

linux.quote: Tangle Sandbox gives applications isolated Linux computers for code, agents, evaluation, CI, and remote development.

isolation.quote: runtime: "firecracker" runs a microVM instead of a container; omit it for the platform default.
isolation.note: The default runtime is not published, so the general mode stays null. The firecracker mode sets isolation "firecracker". Overview: "A sandbox may run through a managed container, a microVM, or an operator-backed driver".

docker_inside.note: No public doc says Docker runs inside a sandbox.

root.note: No public doc says the sandbox user has root.

regions.note: No public region list. The API schema has a free-form driver.preferredRegion string with no published values.

max_size.note: No public page states size limits. The cited sdk/access page is gone (404).

confidential_compute.note: Comparison row marked for Tangle; the page says Tangle 'is the only one with platform-level attestation today'. Not a card feature key.

desktop.quote: Shell, files, ports, desktop and trace from the SDK and CLI.
desktop.note: Advertised on the product page. No frame rate, stream or embed API is documented.

secret_proxy.quote: A name whose stored secret has a proxy policy, or a --proxy-secret binding, keeps the value out of the sandbox and sends it to the policy's hosts only
secret_proxy.note: The policy names the hosts, so it covers any API you register, not only model providers.
